name: vc-ai-infra-scout
description:
Deal-sourcing scout for a VC running a multi-track thesis: AI infrastructure (inference/serving, GPU & compute, training stacks, vector/data infra, agent infra, model-ops), crypto-AI / decentralized-AI / DePIN-for-AI, robotics / embodied-AI (foundation models, humanoid, sim-to-real, actuation/sensor stacks), and agentic payments (x402/stablecoin agent settlement, agent commerce).

HOW IT WORKS: Runs a 9-step discovery pipeline across Tavily (broad web), Parallel (Product Hunt), Exa (funding context), Twitter/X (founder buzz, fundraising news, investor thesis), LinkedIn (funding posts), and Apollo (people + org enrichment).

IMPORTANT — ROBOTICS / MODEL-LAYER QUERIES: Earlier versions hardcoded step 1 to Hacker News only, which misses robotics foundation-model startups (they surface more on TechCrunch, The Information, arXiv, and Twitter). v1.1 broadens step 1 to a general web search scoped to startup + funding signals. For robotics, still supplement with direct SELAT Twitter/X advanced_search and Tavily keyword queries because the robotics FM layer is earlier and more stealth than infra.

SYNTHESIS EXPECTATION: The agent must synthesize all 9 steps into a tiered intelligence memo — not a bare bullet list. Group findings by funding-tier (mega-round, well-funded early, stealth/seed), identify the live investor thesis from Twitter/X investor chatter, flag geographic and pipeline blindspots, and connect cross-source corroboration. The output should read like a VC associate memo.

Paid per call across mixed rails (x402 via Circle Gateway + MPP on Tempo + x402 on Base) via selat-pay (USDC via Circle Gateway), no API keys.

thesis.description: The core search term for web discovery (Tavily, Exa, Apollo). For robotics/embodied-AI use 'robotics foundation model' or 'humanoid robotics'. For crypto-AI use 'decentralized AI compute'. For agentic payments use 'agentic payment rails'. This term is used as ${thesis}.

twitterQuery.description: Twitter/X keyword search for FOUNDER buzz and company chatter. Override to match your thesis: for robotics use 'robotics foundation model'; for humanoid use 'humanoid robot startup'; for crypto-AI use 'decentralized AI compute founder'. (used as ${twitterQuery}).

fundraisingQuery.default: startup raised seed pre-seed funding round
fundraisingQuery.description: Keyword query for FUNDRAISING NEWS on Twitter/X and LinkedIn. For robotics use 'robotics startup raised seed funding'; for agentic payments use 'agentic payment startup raise'. (used as ${fundraisingQuery}).

investorQuery.description: Twitter/X keyword search for INVESTOR / fund-partner chatter. Override for your thesis: for robotics use 'robotics seed fund partner'; for AI infra use 'AI infra VC partner thesis'. (used as ${investorQuery}).

domain.description: The top-ranked company's domain for the org-enrichment step (Apollo). You MUST override this to the most interesting company surfaced by the pipeline; otherwise the enrichment will be generic. (used as ${domain}).

steps.label: broad web discovery — Tavily advanced search for ${thesis} + startup/funding signals (x402 on Base)
Product Hunt discovery — Parallel web search scoped to PH launches (MPP on Tempo)
launch + funding web context — Exa search (MPP on Tempo)
Twitter/X founder & buzz search — SELAT advanced_search (x402 via Circle Gateway)
fundraising news on Twitter/X — SELAT advanced_search for recent pre-seed/seed raises (x402 via Circle Gateway)
fundraising news on LinkedIn — Tavily advanced search scoped to LinkedIn posts (x402 on Base)
lead-investor thesis tweets — SELAT advanced_search over the funds leading those rounds (x402 via Circle Gateway)
founder shortlist — Apollo people-search (MPP on Tempo)
company enrichment — Apollo org-enrichment (MPP on Tempo)
